visual.name: atlasTime
visual.description: Calendar heatmap, heat grid and punch card, stream graph and a timeline slicer that filters the report, with flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Time_Desc: A date (calendar, timeline slicer), the x-axis of a stream graph, or the columns of a heat grid (for example Hour).
en-US.Role_Rows_Desc: Heat grid and punch card: the rows (for example Weekday).
en-US.Role_Series_Desc: Stream graph: one stream per value.
en-US.Landing_Line1: Add a date (or a time field such as Hour) to Time and a measure to Values.
en-US.Landing_Line2: Add Rows for a heat grid or a Legend for a stream graph. Pick calendar, heat grid, stream or timeline slicer in the Format pane.
en-US.Need_Dates: This chart needs a date in Time.
en-US.Need_Two_Times: A stream graph needs two or more points in Time.
en-US.Warn_Target_Text: The timeline filters a plain date column. Use the date field itself, not its date hierarchy.
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There is more data than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual

dataRoles.name: time
dataRoles.description: A date (calendar, timeline slicer), the x-axis of a stream graph, or the columns of a heat grid (for example Hour).

dataRoles.name: rows
dataRoles.description: Heat grid and punch card: the rows (for example Weekday).

dataRoles.name: series
dataRoles.description: Stream graph: one stream per value.
